breakdown.description: Thin airfoil theory (linear small-angle model) is applied at a large angle of attack where stall/nonlinear effects dominate.
breakdown.reason: The Agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The core issue is that thin airfoil theory is invalid at a 20-degree angle of attack due to stall. The ground truth corrects this by suggesting either using a smaller angle or a different model. The Agent, however, proceeded with the user's flawed request, calculated the lift coefficient using the linear formula at 20 degrees, and only added a note at the end that the calculation assumes small angles. This does not fix the error; it performs the incorrect calculation and then adds a disclaimer, effectively repeating the user's mistake.
